routeHint: Sidebar -> Organization -> Organisational Chart. Requires Settings -> Modules -> Users & Profiles -> Profile Settings -> Organizational Chart to be ON and User Types & Roles -> Enable Roles to be ON. Pick a tenant whose roles have members assigned so the boxes show counts and avatars; oncr has 27k users and 1545 units.
alt: Organizational chart with Central, Parent local centers, Chapters and Team sections, each role shown as a box with the number of members holding it
notes: Central roles carry distinct titles (chart_name cleared on the demo tenant); every section in frame has at least one populated role box.

routeHint: Open the chart, then click a role box in the Chapters section that shows a member count. Chapter level roles are the ones that render the chapter dropdown plus the Group column, which is what this image needs to show.
alt: Role member list showing the role name and holder count, a chapter filter, and rows with member name, group and date

routeHint: Open the chart as a user with ADMIN_TENANT, then click Edit Positions in the top left. The Add level buttons, the plus buttons on each row and the row drag handles only render in this mode.
alt: Chart in edit mode showing Add level buttons, plus buttons on each row and drag handles on role boxes

routeHint: Sidebar -> Organization -> Official documents. Requires Settings -> Modules -> Files & eDocuments -> Official Gazette -> Enable Official Gazette Module to be ON. preper (Civic Renewal Alliance) has gazette rows locally.
alt: Official documents list with type filter, text search, and rows showing document date, download icon, title, type and who added it
notes: The existing file shows an empty list (No documents available at this moment). Capture a tenant with real rows so the Document date, Download, Title, Type, Added by and Actions columns are all visible.

routeHint: Official documents -> click the pencil in the Actions column of any row (needs HR_TENANT). Use the edit screen rather than /gazette/create, so the Download document and Upload document buttons at the top of the form are visible alongside the fields.
alt: Official document form with Status radio buttons, Type select, Subject, Document number, Document date and Content fields

routeHint: Official documents -> click a title in the Title column. Pick a row that has a file attached (a download icon in the Download column) and a document number, so the Download link and Document number lines both render.
alt: Single official document showing subject, who created it, document number and date, and a download link for the attached file
